claims.statement: In Indonesian folklore, Orang Pendek (Indonesian for 'short person') is the most common name for a creature said to inhabit remote mountain forests on the island of Sumatra.
claims.statement_id: Dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, Orang Pendek (bahasa Indonesia: 'orang pendek') adalah nama paling umum untuk makhluk yang konon menghuni hutan pegunungan terpencil di Pulau Sumatra.
claims.quote: In Indonesian folklore, the Orang Pendek (Indonesian for 'short person') is the most common name given to a creature said to inhabit remote, mountainous forests on the island of Sumatra.

claims.statement: Witnesses agree the primate is a ground-dwelling, bipedal ape with short fur, 80–150 cm tall.
claims.statement_id: Para saksi sepakat bahwa primata ini adalah kera yang hidup di tanah, berjalan dengan dua kaki, berbulu pendek, dengan tinggi 80–150 cm.
claims.quote: Consensus among witnesses is that the primate is a ground-dwelling, bipedal ape covered in short fur, standing between 80 and 150 cm (31.5 and 59 in) tall.

claims.statement: Claimed sightings have occurred mostly in Kerinci Regency, central Sumatra, especially within Kerinci Seblat National Park.
claims.statement_id: Penampakan yang diklaim sebagian besar terjadi di Kabupaten Kerinci, Sumatra bagian tengah, terutama di Taman Nasional Kerinci Seblat.
claims.quote: claimed sightings have occurred largely within the Kerinci Regency of central Sumatra and especially within the borders of Kerinci Seblat National Park

claims.statement: According to Suku Anak Dalam legends, Orang Pendek has for centuries been part of their world and a co-inhabitant of the forest.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda Suku Anak Dalam, Orang Pendek telah berabad-abad menjadi bagian dunia mereka dan sesama penghuni hutan.
claims.quote: According to their legends, Orang Pendek has been a part of their world and a co-inhabitant of the forest for centuries.

claims.statement: The Suku Anak Dalam are nomadic groups who have traditionally lived in the lowland forests of Jambi and South Sumatra.
claims.statement_id: Suku Anak Dalam adalah kelompok masyarakat nomaden yang secara tradisional tinggal di hutan dataran rendah Jambi dan Sumatra Selatan.
claims.quote: are groups of nomadic people who have traditionally lived throughout the lowland forests of Jambi and South Sumatra

claims.statement: The Orang Rimba of Bukit Duabelas speak of the Hantu Pendek, closely matching Orang Pendek but seen as a supernatural entity or demon rather than an animal; the name means 'short ghost'.
claims.statement_id: Orang Rimba di Bukit Duabelas mengenal Hantu Pendek yang ciri-cirinya sangat mirip Orang Pendek, tetapi dianggap makhluk gaib atau setan, bukan hewan; namanya berarti 'hantu pendek'.
claims.quote: In Bukit Duabelas, the Orang Rimba speak of a creature, known as "Hantu Pendek", whose description closely matches that of Orang Pendek. However, Hantu Pendek is thought of more as a supernatural entity or demon rather than an animal, with the name translating to "short ghost".

claims.statement: According to the Orang Rimba, the Hantu Pendek travel in groups of five or six, live on wild yams, hunt with small axes, and ambush hunters traveling alone in the forest.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Orang Rimba, Hantu Pendek berkelompok lima atau enam, makan ubi hutan, berburu dengan kapak kecil, dan menyergap pemburu yang berjalan sendirian di hutan.
claims.quote: According to the Orang Rimba, the Hantu Pendek travel in groups of five or six, subsisting on wild yams and hunting animals with small axes. Accounts of the creature claim it ambushes unfortunate Orang Rimba hunters traveling alone in the forest.

claims.statement: Along the Makekal River, people tell a legend of their ancestors outsmarting these cunning but dim-witted creatures while hunting; the story is used to boast of their intellect.
claims.statement_id: Di sepanjang Sungai Makekal, orang menceritakan legenda leluhur mereka mengakali makhluk licik tetapi bodoh ini saat berburu; cerita itu dipakai untuk membanggakan kecerdasan mereka.
claims.quote: Along the Makekal River on the western edge of Bukit Duabelas, people recount a legend of how their ancestors outsmarted these cunning yet dim-witted creatures during a hunting trip, and the story is often used to boast of their intellect and reason.

claims.statement: Dutch settlers in the early 20th century introduced Westerners to Orang Pendek-like animals in Sumatra.
claims.statement_id: Pemukim Belanda pada awal abad ke-20 memperkenalkan hewan mirip Orang Pendek di Sumatra kepada orang Barat.
claims.quote: Dutch settlers in the early 20th century provided Westerners with their modern introduction to Orang Pendek-like animals in Sumatra.

claims.statement: Van Heerwarden described an encounter while surveying land in 1923.
claims.statement_id: Van Heerwarden menggambarkan pertemuannya dengan makhluk ini saat mensurvei lahan pada tahun 1923.
claims.quote: Mr van Heerwarden, who described an encounter he had while surveying land in 1923

claims.statement: Van Heerwarden wrote that the creature's face was neither repulsive nor ugly, nor at all apelike.
claims.statement_id: Van Heerwarden menulis bahwa wajah makhluk itu tidak menjijikkan atau jelek, dan sama sekali tidak mirip kera.
claims.quote: There was nothing repulsive or ugly about its face, nor was it at all apelike.

claims.statement: Orang pendek is also called uhang pandak.
claims.statement_id: Orang pendek juga disebut uhang pandak.
claims.quote: orang pendek (uhang pandak) adalah nama paling umum yang diberikan kepada makhluk yang konon menghuni daerah terpencil

claims.statement: This bipedal ape-like creature was first recorded in Western literature by Dutch colonialists in the late 1800s.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk mirip kera berkaki dua ini pertama kali dicatat dalam literatur Barat oleh penjajah Belanda pada akhir abad ke-19.
claims.quote: It’s a bipedal ape-like creature first recorded in Western literature by Dutch colonialists back in the late 1800s.

claims.statement: R. Dally Sandradiputra, a writer from Sungai Penuh, Jambi, began searching for Orang Pendek in 2009 around Mount Kerinci and its national park.
claims.statement_id: R. Dally Sandradiputra, penulis dari Sungai Penuh, Jambi, mulai mencari Orang Pendek pada 2009 di sekitar Gunung Kerinci dan taman nasionalnya.
claims.quote: Dally, a writer from Sungai Penuh, Jambi, launched a search for the mythical orang pendek back in 2009, focusing his efforts on the island’s Kerinci Mountain and national park.

claims.statement: According to VICE, Indonesia's scientific community treats Orang Pendek as a joke and cryptozoology as an attempt to prove a myth.
claims.statement_id: Menurut VICE, kalangan ilmiah Indonesia menganggap Orang Pendek sebagai lelucon dan pencarian kriptozoologi sebagai upaya membuktikan mitos.
claims.quote: To Indonesia’s scientific community, the orang pendek is a joke, and crypto-zoologists are engaged in little more than a laughable attempt to prove the existence of a myth.

claims.statement: According to Dally, the mythology varies; some local folk tales say these creatures are cursed and exiled to the forest, and the stories sometimes conflict.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Dally, mitosnya beragam; sebagian cerita rakyat setempat menyebut makhluk ini terkutuk dan diasingkan ke hutan, dan ceritanya kadang bertentangan.
claims.quote: The mythology comes in many varieties, with some local folk tales saying that these creatures are cursed and exiled to the forest. But the stories are sometimes conflicting.

claims.statement: According to Kerinci locals, the orang pendek walks upright like a human.
claims.statement_id: Menurut penduduk Kerinci, Orang Pendek berjalan tegak seperti manusia.
claims.quote: From what the locals say, the orang pendek walks upright like a human being.

claims.statement: Local folklore also has the cigau and the orang gadang, a kind of local bigfoot.
claims.statement_id: Cerita rakyat setempat juga mengenal cigau dan orang gadang, semacam bigfoot lokal.
claims.quote: there is the cigau (a prehistoric tiger) and also the orang gadang, which can be described as a local bigfoot.

claims.statement: Some stories describe them as forest guardians able to vanish or hide from human sight.
claims.statement_id: Beberapa kisah menggambarkan mereka sebagai penjaga hutan yang dapat menghilang atau bersembunyi dari pandangan manusia.
claims.quote: Beberapa kisah menggambarkan mereka sebagai penjaga hutan yang memiliki kemampuan menghilang atau bersembunyi dari pandangan manusia.

claims.statement: Villagers often take their presence as an omen of good fortune or disaster.
claims.statement_id: Keberadaan mereka sering dianggap penduduk desa sebagai pertanda keberuntungan atau bencana.
claims.quote: Keberadaan mereka sering dianggap sebagai pertanda atau penanda tertentu bagi penduduk desa, terutama dalam hal-hal yang berkaitan dengan keberuntungan atau bencana.

claims.statement: In 2003, an Indonesian and British research team made a joint expedition to look for physical evidence of Orang Pendek.
claims.statement_id: Pada 2003, tim peneliti Indonesia dan Inggris mengadakan ekspedisi bersama untuk mencari bukti fisik Orang Pendek.
claims.quote: Pada tahun 2003, sebuah tim peneliti dari Indonesia dan Inggris melakukan ekspedisi bersama untuk mencari bukti fisik Manusia Pendek.

claims.statement: The team gathered local testimony and surveyed the forest but found no definitive evidence.
claims.statement_id: Tim itu mengumpulkan kesaksian penduduk dan menyurvei hutan, tetapi tidak menemukan bukti definitif.
claims.quote: Mereka mengumpulkan berbagai kesaksian dari penduduk lokal dan melakukan survei di dalam hutan, namun sekali lagi, tidak ada bukti definitif yang ditemukan.

claims.statement: JambiLINK calls Van Herwaarden a British explorer who in the 1920s reported seeing the creature on Mount Kerinci.
claims.statement_id: JambiLINK menyebut Van Herwaarden sebagai penjelajah Inggris yang pada 1920-an melaporkan melihat makhluk ini di Gunung Kerinci.
claims.quote: Pada tahun 1920-an, seorang penjelajah Inggris, Van Herwaarden, melaporkan melihat makhluk yang menyerupai deskripsi Manusia Pendek saat melakukan ekspedisi di Gunung Kerinci.

claims.statement: According to legend, the Manusia Pendek is a small creature that walks upright, about one meter tall, with thick hair all over its body.
claims.statement_id: Menurut legenda, Manusia Pendek adalah makhluk kecil yang berjalan tegak, tingginya sekitar satu meter, dengan rambut tebal di seluruh tubuh.
claims.quote: Menurut legenda, Manusia Pendek adalah makhluk kecil yang berjalan tegak seperti manusia, tetapi dengan tinggi badan yang hanya sekitar satu meter. Mereka dikatakan memiliki rambut tebal di seluruh tubuh

claims.statement: According to traditional Balinese mythology, Rangda (Balinese: ᬭᬗ᭄ᬤ) is the demon queen of the leyaks in Bali.
claims.statement_id: Menurut mitologi tradisional Bali, Rangda (aksara Bali: ᬭᬗ᭄ᬤ) adalah ratu iblis para leak di Bali.
claims.quote: Rangda (Balinese: ᬭᬗ᭄ᬤ) is the demon queen of the Leyaks in Bali, according to traditional Balinese mythology.

claims.statement: The child-eating Rangda leads evil witches against Barong, leader of the forces of good; their battle is shown in the Barong dance as the eternal struggle of good and evil.
claims.statement_id: Rangda pemakan anak memimpin pasukan penyihir jahat melawan Barong, pemimpin kekuatan baik; pertarungan mereka ditampilkan dalam tari Barong sebagai pertempuran abadi baik dan jahat.
claims.quote: the child-eating Rangda leads an army of evil witches against the leader of the forces of good — Barong. The battle between Barong and Rangda is featured in a Barong dance which represents the eternal battle between good and evil.

claims.statement: Rangda is an Old Javanese term meaning widow.
claims.statement_id: Rangda adalah istilah Jawa Kuno yang berarti janda.
claims.quote: Rangda is a term in old Javanese that means "widow".

claims.statement: Rangda is depicted as a mostly nude old woman with long unkempt hair, pendulous breasts and claws, with a fanged, goggle-eyed mask and long protruding tongue.
claims.statement_id: Rangda digambarkan sebagai perempuan tua hampir telanjang, berambut panjang kusut, berpayudara menggantung, bercakar, dengan topeng bertaring, bermata melotot, dan lidah panjang menjulur.
claims.quote: She is depicted as a mostly nude old woman, with long and unkempt hair, pendulous breasts, and claws. Her face is traditionally a horrifying fanged and goggle-eyed mask, with a long, protruding tongue.

claims.statement: Rangda is known as a leyak queen, incarnation of Calon Arang, the legendary witch who wreaked havoc in ancient Java under Airlangga in the late 10th century.
claims.statement_id: Rangda dikenal sebagai ratu leak, penjelmaan Calon Arang, penyihir legendaris yang merusak Jawa kuno pada masa Airlangga akhir abad ke-10.
claims.quote: Rangda is known as a Leyak queen, the incarnation of Calon Arang, the legendary witch that wreaked havoc in ancient Java during the reign of Airlangga in the late 10th century.

claims.statement: Rangda is linked to the legend of Calon Arang and to that of Mahendradatta, a divorced and exiled Javanese queen.
claims.statement_id: Rangda dikaitkan dengan legenda Calon Arang dan legenda Mahendradatta, ratu Jawa yang diceraikan dan diasingkan.
claims.quote: Rangda was linked to the legend of Calon Arang and also the legend of the divorced and exiled Javanese queen Mahendradatta.

claims.statement: Rangda's name means widow in Balinese and comes from the 12th-century Javanese-Balinese tale Calonarang.
claims.statement_id: Nama Rangda berarti janda dalam bahasa Bali dan berasal dari kisah legendaris Jawa-Bali abad ke-12, Calonarang.
claims.quote: Rangda’s name means “widow” in Balinese, and it comes from a legendary Javanese-Balinese tale, the 12th-century Calonarang.

claims.statement: Mahendradatta, from whom other interpretations derive Rangda, was wife of the Balinese king Udayana and Airlangga's mother, known for her devotion to Durga in Bali.
claims.statement_id: Mahendradatta, yang oleh tafsiran lain dianggap asal Rangda, adalah istri raja Bali Udayana dan ibu Airlangga, dikenal karena pengabdiannya pada pemujaan Durga di Bali.
claims.quote: She was the wife of Balinese king Udayana and Airlangga's mother. Mahendradatta is known for her devotion to the cult of Durga in Bali.

claims.statement: Calon Arang was a widow skilled in black magic who damaged crops and brought disease; her daughter Ratna Manggali could not find a husband because people feared her mother.
claims.statement_id: Calon Arang adalah janda penguasa ilmu hitam yang merusak panen dan mendatangkan penyakit; putrinya, Ratna Manggali, tidak mendapat suami karena orang takut pada ibunya.
claims.quote: It is said that Calon Arang was a widow, who had mastered the art of black magic, who often damaged farmers' crops and caused disease to come. She had a daughter, named Ratna Manggali, who, though beautiful, could not get a husband because people were afraid of her mother.

claims.statement: In Balinese Hinduism, Rangda is the supreme manifestation of the evil aspects of power.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Hindu Bali, Rangda adalah perwujudan tertinggi aspek jahat dari kekuatan.
claims.quote: In the unique form of Hinduism practiced in Bali, Rangda is the supreme manifestation of the evil aspects of power.

claims.statement: In performance Rangda moves wildly like an animal with reckless gestures and a leaping gait.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pertunjukan, Rangda bergerak liar seperti binatang dengan gerak sembrono dan langkah melompat.
claims.quote: her wild and untamed energy is made visible as she moves animal-like, with reckless gestures and a leaping gait.

claims.statement: As a manifestation of Durga, Rangda is consort of the god Siwa; her realm is the cemetery, and her sacred masks are kept in village temples of the dead.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai perwujudan Durga, Rangda adalah pasangan Dewa Siwa; wilayahnya adalah kuburan, dan topeng sakralnya disimpan di pura desa untuk orang mati (pura dalem).
claims.quote: As the manifestation of the great Hindu goddess Durga, Rangda is the consort of the god Siwa the destroyer (known as Shiva in Sanskrit). Her realm is the cemetery, and sacred masks of Rangda are kept in the nearby village temples of the dead

claims.statement: In the battle reenacted at least once a year in Balinese villages, Rangda is defeated but never killed, since her negative energy coexists with the positive.
claims.statement_id: Dalam pertarungan yang dipentaskan setidaknya setahun sekali di desa-desa Bali, Rangda dikalahkan tetapi tidak pernah dibunuh, karena energi negatifnya hidup berdampingan dengan yang positif.
claims.quote: In the ensuing battle—one that is reenacted at least once a year in villages throughout Bali—Rangda is defeated but never killed, since her negative energy co-exists with the positive.

claims.statement: Research shows Rangda's role in Bali is more than an artistic device; she also serves a religious function as a sacred symbol.
claims.statement_id: Penelitian menunjukkan peran Rangda di Bali lebih dari sekadar perangkat seni; ia juga berfungsi religius sebagai simbol sakral.
claims.quote: However, further research shows that Rangda’s role in Bali is more than an artistic device; she also serves an important religious function as a sacred symbol

claims.statement: Rwa Bhineda, a Balinese philosophy of balance between two opposing poles, is explicitly manifested in the relationship of Rangda and Barong.
claims.statement_id: Rwa Bhineda, filosofi Bali tentang keseimbangan dua kutub berlawanan, tampak nyata dalam hubungan Rangda dan Barong.
claims.quote: Rwa Bhineda, a Balinese philosophy that emphasizes the balance between two opposing polarities, finds its explicit manifestation in the relationship between Rangda and Barong.

claims.statement: The Lontar Siwa Tattwa and Lontar Usada Taru Premana identify Rangda as the goddess Durga on earth with the title Hyang Bherawi.
claims.statement_id: Lontar Siwa Tattwa dan Lontar Usada Taru Premana menyebut Rangda perwujudan Dewi Durga di bumi dengan gelar Hyang Bherawi.
claims.quote: This view is reinforced by the Lontar Siwa Tattwa and Lontar Usada Taru Premana, which identify Rangda as the embodiment of the goddess Durga on earth with the title Hyang Bherawi

claims.statement: In Balinese Hinduism, the struggle to maintain or restore the cosmological balance of opposing forces, such as good and evil, permeates all of life.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Hindu Bali, upaya menjaga atau memulihkan keseimbangan kosmologis kekuatan yang berlawanan, seperti baik dan jahat, meresapi seluruh kehidupan.
claims.quote: In Balinese Hinduism, the struggle to maintain or return the cosmological balance of opposing forces, such as good and evil or life and death, permeates all of life.

claims.statement: King Airlangga asked his advisor Empu Bharada to deal with the problem; Empu Bharada sent his disciple Empu Bahula to marry Ratna.
claims.statement_id: Raja Airlangga meminta penasihatnya, Empu Bharada, menangani masalah ini; Empu Bharada mengutus muridnya, Empu Bahula, untuk menikahi Ratna.
claims.quote: King Airlangga, who had heard of this matter, then asked for his advisor, Empu Bharada, to deal with this problem. Empu Bharada then sent his disciple, Empu Bahula, to be married to Ratna.

claims.statement: Empu Bahula found Calon Arang's book and gave it to Empu Bharada; the angry Calon Arang fought Empu Bharada and, without Durga's help, was defeated.
claims.statement_id: Empu Bahula menemukan kitab mantra Calon Arang dan menyerahkannya kepada Empu Bharada; Calon Arang yang marah melawan Empu Bharada dan kalah tanpa bantuan Durga.
claims.quote: One day, this book was found by Empu Bahula, who turned it over to Empu Bharada. As soon as Calon Arang knew that the book had been stolen, she became angry and decided to fight Empu Bharada. Without the help of Durga, Calon Arang was defeated.

claims.statement: The next day a great flood engulfed the village, many died, and disease appeared.
claims.statement_id: Keesokan harinya banjir besar melanda desa, banyak orang meninggal, dan penyakit muncul.
claims.quote: The next day, a great flood engulfed the village and many people died. Disease also appeared.

claims.statement: Nats (နတ်) are god-like spirits venerated in Myanmar and neighbouring countries alongside Buddhism; the 37 Great Nats received that status from King Anawrahta.
claims.statement_id: Nat (နတ်) adalah roh serupa dewa yang dipuja di Myanmar dan negara sekitarnya bersama agama Buddha; ada 37 Nat Agung yang statusnya diberikan Raja Anawrahta.
claims.quote: The nats (နတ်; MLCTS: nat; IPA: [naʔ]) are god-like spirits venerated in Myanmar and neighbouring countries in conjunction with Buddhism. They are divided between the 37 Great Nats who were given that status by King Anawrahta

claims.statement: Most of the 37 Great Nats were humans who died violently; there are two kinds of nats: nat sein (humans deified after death) and nature spirits such as those of water and trees.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian besar 37 Nat Agung adalah manusia yang mati secara kejam; ada dua jenis nat: nat sein (manusia yang didewakan setelah mati) dan roh alam seperti roh air dan pohon.
claims.quote: Most of the 37 Great Nats were human beings who met violent deaths. There are two types of nats in Burmese Belief: nat sein (နတ်စိမ်း), which are humans that were deified after their deaths, and all other nats, which are spirits of nature (spirits of water, trees etc.).

claims.statement: Every Burmese village has a shrine for the village guardian nat (ywa saung nat), and houses have a nat shrine, usually a coconut hung in a corner of the house.
claims.statement_id: Setiap desa Myanmar punya kuil untuk nat penjaga desa (ywa saung nat), dan rumah-rumah punya tempat pemujaan nat, biasanya kelapa yang digantung di sudut rumah.
claims.quote: Every Burmese village has a nat kun (နတ်ကွန်း) or nat sin (နတ်စင်), which essentially serves as a shrine to the village guardian nat called the ywa saung nat (ရွာစောင့်နတ်). Individual houses also have a shrine to a nat, usually a coconut is hung on a corner of the house

claims.statement: Nat worship predates Buddhism in Burma; after Buddhism arrived, the nats were syncretically merged with it.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan nat lebih tua daripada agama Buddha di Myanmar; setelah Buddha datang, nat dilebur secara sinkretis dengan agama Buddha.
claims.quote: Worship of nats predates Buddhism in Burma. With the arrival of Buddhism, however, the nats were syncretically merged with Buddhism.

claims.statement: Anawrahta used traditional nat spirits to attract people to his new religion.
claims.statement_id: Anawrahta memakai roh nat tradisional untuk menarik rakyat ke agama barunya.
claims.quote: Anawrahta used traditional nat spirits to attract people to his new religion.

claims.statement: The rural belief in forest (taw saung nat) and mountain (taung saung nat) guardian spirits appears to deter environmental destruction up to a point.
claims.statement_id: Kepercayaan pedesaan pada roh penjaga hutan (taw saung nat) dan gunung (taung saung nat) tampaknya menjadi penghalang perusakan lingkungan sampai batas tertentu.
claims.quote: The widespread traditional belief among rural communities that there are forest guardian spirits called taw saung nats (တောစောင့်နတ်) and mountain guardian spirits called taung saung nats (တောင်စောင့်နတ်) appears to act as a deterrent against environmental destruction, up to a point.

claims.statement: Burma's most important nat pilgrimage site is Mount Popa, a 1,300-metre extinct volcano near Bagan.
claims.statement_id: Tempat ziarah nat terpenting di Myanmar adalah Gunung Popa, gunung api mati setinggi 1.300 meter di dekat Bagan.
claims.quote: The most important nat pilgrimage site in Burma is Mount Popa, an extinct volcano with numerous temples and relic sites atop a 1,300-metre-tall (4,300 ft) mountain located near Bagan in central Burma.

claims.statement: Nats are given human characteristics, wants and needs, including desires considered immoral in mainstream Buddhism.
claims.statement_id: Nat dianggap punya sifat, keinginan, dan kebutuhan manusia, termasuk keinginan yang dianggap tidak bermoral dalam Buddha arus utama.
claims.quote: Nats are ascribed human characteristics, wants, and needs; they are flawed, having desires considered derogatory and immoral in mainstream Buddhism.

claims.statement: At a nat pwè, a festival to propitiate nats, nat kadaws (spirit mediums) dance and embody the nats.
claims.statement_id: Dalam nat pwè, festival untuk menenangkan nat, para nat kadaw (medium roh) menari dan menjadi wadah nat.
claims.quote: During a nat pwè, which is a festival during which nats are propitiated, nat kadaws (နတ်ကတော် "wife of the spirit", i.e. "medium, shaman") dance and embody the nats.

claims.statement: Taungbyone north of Mandalay is a major nat festival site each Wagaung; Yadanagu at Amarapura is held a week later in honour of Popa Medaw.
claims.statement_id: Taungbyone di utara Mandalay adalah situs festival nat besar setiap bulan Wagaung; festival Yadanagu di Amarapura diadakan seminggu kemudian untuk menghormati Popa Medaw.
claims.quote: Taungbyone, north of Mandalay in Madaya Township, is another major site with the festival held each year starting on the eleventh waxing day and including the full moon in the month Wagaung (August). Yadanagu at Amarapura, held a week later in honour of Popa Medaw

claims.statement: Nat kadaws emerged as an independent profession in the latter half of the 19th century, and nat kannahs are more an urban phenomenon for migrants from the countryside.
claims.statement_id: Nat kadaw muncul sebagai profesi mandiri pada paruh kedua abad ke-19, dan nat kannah lebih merupakan gejala kota bagi pendatang dari desa.
claims.quote: The nat kadaws as an independent profession made their appearance in the latter half of the 19th century as spirit mediums, and nat kannahs are more of an urban phenomenon which evolved to satisfy the need of people who had migrated from the countryside to towns and cities

claims.statement: Academic opinions differ on whether Burmese Buddhism and spirit worship are separate or a single religion.
claims.statement_id: Pendapat akademik berbeda apakah Buddha Myanmar dan pemujaan roh Myanmar adalah dua hal terpisah atau satu agama.
claims.quote: Academic opinions vary as to whether Burmese Buddhism and Burmese spirit worship are two separate entities or merged into a single religion.

claims.statement: The 37 Great Nats, recognized since the 11th century, were once high-status humans; all but Thagyamin died violently or painfully, e.g. snake bites, leprosy, beheading, immolation, drowning or falling off a swing.
claims.statement_id: 37 Nat Agung, yang diakui sejak abad ke-11, dulunya manusia berstatus tinggi; semua kecuali Thagyamin mati secara kejam atau menyakitkan, misalnya gigitan ular, kusta, dipenggal, dibakar, tenggelam, atau jatuh dari ayunan.
claims.quote: The 37 Great Nats, first recognized during the 11th century, were once high-status humans. All but one—Thagyamin, the lucky sod—perished in violent or painful circumstances. Snake bites, leprosy, beheading, forceful immolation, drowning, and falling off a swing are but a few of the myriad ways in which they died.

claims.statement: Pilgrims climb Taung Kalat's 777 stairs to leave offerings at its summit shrines; money is standard, but other items suit the nat, such as whisky for Min Kyawzwa.
claims.statement_id: Peziarah menaiki 777 anak tangga Taung Kalat untuk meletakkan persembahan di kuil-kuil puncaknya; uang adalah persembahan umum, tetapi barang lain disesuaikan dengan nat, misalnya wiski untuk Min Kyawzwa.
claims.quote: Pilgrims climb the 777 stairs of Taung Kalat—barefoot and dodging monkey dung along the way—to leave offerings at the colorful shrines located at the summit. Money is the standard gift, but other items are acceptable according to the nat in question. Min Kyawzwa, a nat known for his alcoholism and antagonistic personality, is regularly honored with bottles of whisky.

claims.statement: There are guardian spirits of trees, mountains, land, houses, villages, towns, the country and roads; some overlap, e.g. Min Mahagiri, leader of the 37 and protector of the household.
claims.statement_id: Ada roh penjaga pohon, gunung, tanah, rumah, desa, kota, negara, dan jalan; sebagian nat masuk beberapa golongan, misalnya Min Mahagiri, pemimpin jajaran 37 sekaligus pelindung rumah.
claims.quote: Guardian Spirits of tree, mountain, land house, village, town, country, roads. Some Nat Spirits overlap categories: Min Mahagiri is a leader of the 37 Pantheon and also a protector Nat of the household.

claims.statement: Throughout Myanmar there are hundreds of different nats supplicated through local and regional ceremonies (pwe).
claims.statement_id: Di seluruh Myanmar ada ratusan nat berbeda yang dipuja lewat upacara lokal dan daerah (pwe).
claims.quote: Actually, throughout Myanmar, there are hundreds and hundreds of different “Nat” Spirits who are supplicated through local and regional ceremonies (pwe)

claims.statement: The number 37 is a mystical ordering, said to come from Hindu cosmology, used often in Burmese history since the Bagan period.
claims.statement_id: Angka 37 adalah urutan mistis, konon dari kosmologi Hindu, yang sering dipakai dalam sejarah Myanmar sejak masa Bagan.
claims.quote: The number “37” is used as a mystical ordering (said to originate from Hindu cosmology) used frequently throughout Burmese history since the Bagan period.

claims.statement: The formalizing of the 37 Great Nats by King Anawrahta (1044–1077) of Bagan has been interpreted as Burmanisation and the establishment of Bamar supremacy in the Irrawaddy valley.
claims.statement_id: Penetapan resmi 37 Nat Agung oleh Raja Anawrahta (1044–1077) dari Bagan ditafsirkan sebagai burmanisasi dan penegakan dominasi Bamar di lembah Irrawaddy.
claims.quote: The formalizing of the official 37 Great Nats by King Anawrahta (1044–1077) of Bagan, has been interpreted as Burmanisation and establishment of Bamar supremacy in the Irrawaddy valley

claims.statement: Nats who are deceased humans still in limbo between lives are called nat sein, those who died a violent death; they make up most of the 37.
claims.statement_id: Nat yang merupakan manusia yang telah meninggal dan masih terjebak di antara kehidupan disebut nat sein, yaitu mereka yang mati secara kejam; merekalah sebagian besar jajaran 37.
claims.quote: Nat Spirits who are deceased humans still in limbo between lives, stuck in their regret or bitterness. THESE are the predominant Pantheon of 37, called “Nat Sein” – those who died a violent death

issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: kategori "Nyai Roro Kidul", dipakai di en.wikipedia.org: Nyai Roro Kidul. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: Nyi Roro Kidul (or Nyai Rara Kidul) is a supernatural being in Indonesian folklore, the Queen of the Southern Sea in Sundanese and Javanese mythology.
claims.statement_id: Nyi Roro Kidul (atau Nyai Rara Kidul) adalah makhluk gaib dalam cerita rakyat Indonesia, Ratu Laut Selatan dalam mitologi Sunda dan Jawa.
claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul (or Nyai Rara Kidul) is a supernatural being in Indonesian folklore. She is the Queen of the Southern Sea in Sundanese and Javanese mythology.

claims.statement: Some equate Nyi Roro Kidul with Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, but in Kejawen she is Kanjeng Ratu Kidul's loyal subordinate.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian orang menyamakan Nyi Roro Kidul dengan Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, tetapi dalam Kejawen Nyi Roro Kidul adalah bawahan setia Kanjeng Ratu Kidul.
claims.quote: Some equate Nyi Roro Kidul with Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, although in Kejawen belief, Nyi Roro Kidul is a loyal subordinate of Kanjeng Ratu Kidul.

claims.statement: She is commonly called Ratu Laut Selatan and Gusti Kanjeng Ratu Kidul; honorifics Nyai, Kanjeng and Gusti are used for politeness in Javanese custom.
claims.statement_id: Ia umum disebut Ratu Laut Selatan dan Gusti Kanjeng Ratu Kidul; gelar Nyai, Kanjeng, dan Gusti dipakai demi kesopanan menurut adat Jawa.
claims.quote: She is commonly called by the names Ratu Laut Selatan and Gusti Kanjeng Ratu Kidul. According to Javanese customs, honorifics, such as Nyai, Kanjeng, and Gusti, are used to refer to her for the sake of politeness.

claims.statement: She is also called Nyai Loro Kidul; Javanese loro can mean 'two', 'pain' or 'suffering', while rara (roro) means 'girl'.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga disebut Nyai Loro Kidul; kata Jawa loro dapat berarti 'dua', 'sakit', atau 'penderitaan', sedangkan rara (roro) berarti 'gadis'.
claims.quote: Sometimes, people also refer to her as Nyai Loro Kidul. Javanese loro is a homograph for "two", "pain" or "suffering", while the Javanese rara (or roro) means "girl".

claims.statement: One version tells of Kadita, only daughter of King Munding Wangi of Galuh Pakuan.
claims.statement_id: Satu versi menceritakan Kadita, putri tunggal Raja Munding Wangi dari Galuh Pakuan.
claims.quote: A similar version tells of Kadita, the only daughter of King Munding Wangi of Galuh Pakuan.

claims.statement: Nyi Roro Kidul is sometimes depicted as a mermaid with a snake or fish lower body, sometimes as a very beautiful woman, and is believed to take the soul of anyone she wants.
claims.statement_id: Nyi Roro Kidul kadang digambarkan sebagai putri duyung bertubuh bawah ular atau ikan, kadang sebagai perempuan sangat cantik, dan diyakini dapat mengambil jiwa siapa saja.
claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul is sometimes depicted in the form of a mermaid with her lower body in the form of a snake or fish, sometimes as a very beautiful woman. She is believed to take the soul of anyone she wants.

claims.statement: Sea green (gadhung m'lathi) is Nyi Roro Kidul's favourite colour, and visitors to Java's south coast are warned not to wear green.
claims.statement_id: Hijau laut (gadhung m'lathi) adalah warna kesukaan Nyi Roro Kidul, dan pengunjung pantai selatan Jawa diperingatkan agar tidak berpakaian hijau.
claims.quote: Sea green (gadhung m'lathi in Javanese) is Nyi Roro Kidul's favorite color and no one should wear the color along the southern coast of Java. People visiting the southern coast are warned not to wear green garments.

claims.statement: Palabuhanratu, a fishing town in West Java, holds an annual holiday in her honour on April 6, and local fishermen hold the sedekah laut ceremony every year.
claims.statement_id: Palabuhanratu, kota nelayan di Jawa Barat, merayakan hari untuknya setiap 6 April, dan nelayan setempat menggelar upacara sedekah laut setiap tahun.
claims.quote: Palabuhanratu, a small fishing town in West Java, Indonesia, celebrates an annual holiday in her honor on April 6. The local fishermen annually send the sedekah laut ceremony

claims.statement: According to beliefs in southern Javanese coastal villages, the queen often claims the lives of fishermen or beach bathers, usually preferring handsome young men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan desa pesisir Jawa selatan, sang ratu sering merenggut nyawa nelayan atau pengunjung yang mandi di pantai, terutama pemuda tampan.
claims.quote: According to local popular beliefs around coastal villages in Southern Java, the Queen often claims the lives of fishermen or visitors who bathe on the beach, and she usually prefers handsome young men.

claims.statement: In much folklore, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul controls the violent waves of the Indian Ocean from her dwelling in the heart of the ocean.
claims.statement_id: Dalam banyak cerita, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul menguasai ombak ganas Samudra Hindia dari tempat tinggalnya di tengah samudra.
claims.quote: Kanjeng Ratu Kidul is in control of the violent waves of the Indian Ocean from her dwelling place in the heart of the ocean in a significant amount of the folklore that surrounds her.

claims.statement: Sultan Hamengkubuwono IX wrote in his memoir that the queen could change shape, usually appearing as a beautiful young woman at full moon and as an old woman at other times.
claims.statement_id: Sultan Hamengkubuwono IX dalam memoarnya menulis bahwa sang ratu dapat berubah wujud, biasanya tampil sebagai perempuan muda cantik saat purnama dan perempuan tua di waktu lain.
claims.quote: Sultan Hamengkubuwono IX of Yogyakarta described his experience on spiritual encounters with the spirit Queen in his memoir; the queen could change shapes and appearance, usually appearing as a beautiful young woman during a full moon, and as an old woman at other times.

claims.statement: The Serat Babad Nitik tells of Panembahan Senopati's meeting with the ruler of the southern sea, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, who promised to help him and his descendants.
claims.statement_id: Serat Babad Nitik mengisahkan pertemuan Panembahan Senopati dengan penguasa laut selatan, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul, yang berjanji membantu Senopati dan keturunannya.
claims.quote: Beksan ini mengambil cerita dari Serat Babad Nitik yang mengisahkan pertemuan antara Panembahan Senopati dengan penguasa laut selatan yaitu Kanjeng Ratu Kidul. Dalam pertemuan tersebut Kanjeng Ratu Kidul berjanji akan membantu Panembahan Senopati dan keturunannya.

claims.statement: Bedhaya Lambangsari is a work of Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono VII (1877-1921).
claims.statement_id: Bedhaya Lambangsari adalah karya Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono VII (1877-1921).
claims.quote: Bedhaya Lambangsari merupakan Yasan Dalem (karya) Sri Sultan Hamengku Buwono VII (1877-1921)

claims.statement: According to popular belief, whenever Bedhaya Ketawang is performed, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul attends and dances as the tenth dancer.
claims.statement_id: Menurut kepercayaan masyarakat, setiap kali Bedhaya Ketawang dipentaskan, Kanjeng Ratu Kidul hadir dan ikut menari sebagai penari kesepuluh.
claims.quote: Menurut kepercayaan masyarakat, setiap Tari Bedhaya Ketawang ini dipertunjukkan maka dipercaya Kanjeng Ratu Kidul akan hadir dalam upacara dan ikut menari sebagai penari kesepuluh.

claims.statement: The Samudra Beach Hotel in Palabuhanratu keeps room 308 furnished in green and reserved for Nyai Loro Kidul.
claims.statement_id: Hotel Samudra Beach di Palabuhanratu menyediakan kamar 308 bernuansa hijau yang dipesan untuk Nyai Loro Kidul.
claims.quote: The Samudra Beach Hotel, Palabuhanratu, West Java, keeps room 308 furnished with green colors and reserved for Nyai Loro Kidul.

claims.statement: Nyi Roro Kidul is also associated with Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi and other places on Java's south coast.
claims.statement_id: Nyi Roro Kidul juga dikaitkan dengan Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi, dan tempat lain di pantai selatan Jawa.
claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul is also associated with Parangtritis, Parangkusumo, Pangandaran, Karang Bolong, Ngliyep, Puger, Banyuwangi, and other places along the south coast of Java.

claims.statement: Another Sundanese tale says Banyoe Bening (Banyu Bening, 'clear water') became queen of the Djojo Koelon Kingdom, suffered leprosy, travelled south and was taken by a huge wave into the ocean.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Sunda lain menyebut Banyoe Bening (Banyu Bening, 'air jernih') menjadi ratu Kerajaan Djojo Koelon, menderita kusta, pergi ke selatan, lalu dibawa ombak besar dan lenyap di samudra.
claims.quote: Another Sundanese folktale mentions Banyoe Bening (meaning clear water) becoming Queen of the Djojo Koelon Kingdom. She suffered from leprosy and later traveled to the south, where she was taken by a huge wave to disappear into the Ocean.

claims.statement: Parangkusumo is believed to be the site of the queen's first spiritual encounter with Panembahan Senopati.
claims.statement_id: Parangkusumo diyakini sebagai lokasi pertemuan spiritual pertama sang ratu dengan Panembahan Senopati.
claims.quote: Parangkusumo, in particular, is special since it was the place believed to be the location of the first spiritual encounter between the Queen with Panembahan Senopati.

claims.statement: Nyi Roro Kidul is the patron goddess of South Java's bird's nest gatherers.
claims.statement_id: Nyi Roro Kidul adalah dewi pelindung para pengumpul sarang burung di Jawa bagian selatan.
claims.quote: Nyi Roro Kidul is the patron goddess of the bird's nest gatherers of South Java.

claims.statement: A Sundanese tale tells of Dewi Kadita, a beautiful Sunda princess who fled to the southern ocean after a shaman, at a palace rival’s behest, cursed and disfigured her.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah kisah Sunda menceritakan Dewi Kadita, putri cantik Kerajaan Sunda, yang lari ke samudra selatan setelah dikutuk dukun atas suruhan saingannya di istana hingga wajahnya rusak.
claims.quote: One of the Sundanese folktales tells the story of Dewi Kadita, a beautiful princess of the Sunda Kingdom, who fled to the southern ocean after being cursed by a shaman at the behest of a rival in the palace, which disfigured the princess.

claims.statement: She jumped into the ocean to end her life but was instead cured and restored to beauty; the phantoms then made her the Phantom Queen of the Southern Sea.
claims.statement_id: Ia terjun ke laut untuk bunuh diri, tetapi justru sembuh dan kembali cantik; para makhluk halus lalu menjadikannya Ratu Makhluk Halus Laut Selatan.
claims.quote: She jumped into the ocean, attempting suicide, but instead was cured and restored to beauty. The phantoms then made her the legendary Phantom Queen of the Southern Sea.

claims.statement: Bedhaya Ketawang is called sacred because it may not be danced outside the walls of the Surakarta palace.
claims.statement_id: Bedhaya Ketawang disebut sakral karena tidak boleh ditarikan di luar tembok Keraton Surakarta.
claims.quote: Tari atau beksan ini disebut sakral karena tarian ini tidak boleh ditarikan di luar tembok Keraton Surakarta.

claims.statement: Panembahan Senopati eventually founded the kingdom of Mataram, of which the Yogyakarta palace is one successor.
claims.statement_id: Panembahan Senopati akhirnya mendirikan Kerajaan Mataram, dan Keraton Yogyakarta adalah salah satu penerusnya.
claims.quote: Pada akhirnya Panembahan Senopati berhasil mendirikan sebuah kerajaan, yaitu Mataram dan Keraton Yogyakarta merupakan salah satu kerajaan penerusnya.

claims.statement: Aswang is a general term for various evil shape-shifting creatures in Filipino folklore, such as vampires, ghouls, witches, viscera suckers and human-beast hybrids (usually dogs, cats, pigs).
claims.statement_id: Aswang adalah istilah umum untuk berbagai makhluk jahat pengubah wujud dalam cerita rakyat Filipina, seperti vampir, pemakan mayat, penyihir, pengisap isi perut, dan manusia yang menjelma binatang (biasanya anjing, kucing, babi).
claims.quote: Aswang is a general term used to describe various evil and malevolent shape-shifting creatures found in Filipino folklore, such as vampires, ghouls, witches, viscera suckers, and transforming human-beast hybrids (usually dogs, cats, pigs).

claims.statement: Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared mythical creature of the Philippines, even in the 16th century.
claims.statement_id: Penjajah Spanyol mencatat bahwa aswang adalah makhluk mitos yang paling ditakuti di Filipina, bahkan pada abad ke-16.
claims.quote: Spanish colonists noted that the aswang was the most feared among the mythical creatures of the Philippines, even in the 16th century.

claims.statement: The aswang is especially popular in southern Luzon and parts of Mindanao and the Visayas, especially Capiz province.
claims.statement_id: Aswang sangat populer di Luzon selatan dan sebagian Mindanao serta Visayas, terutama Provinsi Capiz.
claims.quote: The aswang is especially popular in the southern parts of Luzon, and some parts of Mindanao and Visayas, especially the Visayan province of Capiz.

claims.statement: Aswang derives from Greater Central Philippine *aswang ('vampire', 'evil spirit' or 'witch'); Tagalog also has asuwang and uswang.
claims.statement_id: Kata aswang berasal dari bahasa Greater Central Philippine *aswang ('vampir', 'roh jahat', atau 'penyihir'); dalam bahasa Tagalog juga ada bentuk asuwang dan uswang.
claims.quote: Aswang is derived from Greater Central Philippine *aswang ("vampire," "evil spirit," or "witch"). Its cognates include Cebuano, Aklanon, Bikol, and Kapampangan aswang; Tagalog aswang, asuwang, or uswang

claims.statement: According to Maximo Ramos, the aswang categories are the vampire, the self-segmenting viscera sucker, the weredog, the witch and the ghoul.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Maximo Ramos, golongan aswang adalah vampir, pengisap isi perut yang memisahkan tubuhnya, weredog, penyihir, dan pemakan mayat.
claims.quote: These categories are the vampire, the self-segmenting viscera sucker, the weredog, the witch, and the ghoul.

claims.statement: The vampire aswang looks like a beautiful woman and sucks blood with a proboscis-like tongue rather than sharp teeth.
claims.statement_id: Aswang vampir berwujud perempuan cantik dan mengisap darah dengan lidah seperti belalai, bukan dengan gigi runcing.
claims.quote: The vampire aswang takes on the appearance of a beautiful woman. It shares a diet of blood with vampires from Western cultures; however, it differs in that it sucks blood using a proboscis-like tongue rather than sharpened teeth.

claims.statement: By day the manananggal looks like an attractive woman; at night it grows wings, leaves its body from the waist down, and flies in search of victims, especially fetuses in pregnant women.
claims.statement_id: Pada siang hari manananggal berwujud perempuan menarik; pada malam hari ia menumbuhkan sayap, meninggalkan tubuh dari pinggang ke bawah, lalu terbang mencari korban, terutama janin dalam kandungan.
claims.quote: By day, it takes the shape of an attractive, light-skinned, and long-haired woman. At night, it grows wings and segments itself, leaving behind its body from the waist downwards. It takes great care to hide its lower half, then flies in searches for victims. It is particularly attracted to fetuses developing inside pregnant women.

claims.statement: The weredog infiltrates villages and transforms around midnight, most often into a dog but possibly a cat or pig.
claims.statement_id: Weredog menyusup ke desa dan berubah wujud pada malam hari sekitar tengah malam, paling sering menjadi anjing, tetapi bisa juga kucing atau babi.
claims.quote: Like the previous aswang, the weredog infiltrates villages and turns into a creature at night, around midnight. The creature is most commonly a dog, but a cat or pig is also possible.

claims.statement: Witch aswangs are extremely vindictive and curse those who cross them by making rice, bones or insects emerge from the victims' orifices.
claims.statement_id: Aswang penyihir sangat pendendam dan mengutuk orang yang menyinggungnya dengan membuat beras, tulang, atau serangga keluar dari lubang tubuh korban.
claims.quote: Witch aswangs are characterized by extreme vindictiveness; they curse those who have crossed them by causing objects such as rice, bones, or insects to emerge from their victims' bodily orifices.

claims.statement: Ghoul aswangs eat human corpses.
claims.statement_id: Aswang pemakan mayat memakan jenazah manusia.
claims.quote: Their diet consists of human corpses; they are carrion-eaters.

claims.statement: Aswangs usually dwell in cemeteries and woods at night, since their powers are greatly or totally reduced by day.
claims.statement_id: Aswang biasanya berada di kuburan dan hutan pada malam hari, karena kekuatannya sangat berkurang atau hilang pada siang hari.
claims.quote: Aswangs commonly dwell at night in locations such as cemeteries and woods, as their powers are significantly, or sometimes totally, reduced during the daytime.

claims.statement: Traditional aswangs do not discriminate in prey and will target their own kin, an inversion of the traditional Filipino value of family closeness.
claims.statement_id: Aswang tradisional tidak pilih-pilih mangsa dan tak segan memangsa kerabatnya sendiri, kebalikan dari nilai kekeluargaan tradisional Filipina.
claims.quote: Traditional aswang have no bias when selecting their prey and will not hesitate to target their own kin: an inversion of the traditional Filipino value of strong kinship and family closeness.

claims.statement: Holy objects, spices, salt, ash, a stingray's tail, large crustaceans, vinegar, betel chew and urine are listed as protection against aswangs.
claims.statement_id: Benda suci, rempah, garam, abu, ekor ikan pari, krustasea besar, cuka, sirih pinang, dan air seni tercatat sebagai penangkal aswang.
claims.quote: Holy objects, spices, salt, ash, the tail of a stingray, large crustaceans, vinegar, betel nut chew, and urine are all listed as tools for protection against aswang.

claims.statement: The anti-aswang oil is hung at the door and boils when an aswang is near.
claims.statement_id: Minyak anti-aswang digantung di pintu rumah dan akan mendidih bila aswang berada di dekatnya.
claims.quote: Once complete, the oil should be hung at the door of the house; it will boil when an aswang is near.

claims.statement: Because aswangs were believed to cause miscarriages, countermeasures were developed to keep them away during childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Karena aswang diyakini menyebabkan keguguran, berbagai penangkal dikembangkan agar mereka tidak berkeliaran saat persalinan.
claims.quote: Because aswang were believed to be the cause of miscarriages, countermeasures to drive aswang away and prevent them from prowling during childbirth were developed.

claims.statement: Ramos reasons each region's were-creature is named after its fiercest animal; the Philippines has no native wolves, so weredog is more fitting.
claims.statement_id: Ramos beralasan makhluk jelmaan tiap daerah dinamai menurut hewan paling buasnya; karena Filipina tidak punya serigala asli, istilah weredog lebih tepat.
claims.quote: Ramos reasons that the creature of a given region is named after their most ferocious creature. As such, for example, Europe has werewolves, India has weretigers, and Africa has wereleopards. The Philippines has no indigenous wolf population, thus making weredog the more appropriate term.

claims.statement: Plasencia recorded the osuang, equivalent to 'sorcerer'; people claimed to see it fly, kill men and eat their flesh; this was in the Visayas, not among the Tagalogs.
claims.statement_id: Plasencia mencatat osuang, yang setara dengan 'tukang sihir'; orang mengaku melihatnya terbang, membunuh, dan memakan daging manusia; ini ada di Kepulauan Visayas, tidak di antara orang Tagalog.
claims.quote: The eighth they called osuang, which is equivalent to "sorcerer;" they say that they have seen him fly, and that he murdered men and ate their flesh. This was among the Visayas Islands; among the Tagalos these did not exist.

claims.statement: The film Aswang (1992) features a shape-shifting witch, and Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999) a village of ghoul-like creatures.
claims.statement_id: Film Aswang (1992) menampilkan penyihir pengubah wujud, dan Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999) menampilkan desa makhluk mirip pemakan mayat.
claims.quote: a shape shifting witch in Aswang (1992), or a village of ghoul-like creatures in Sa Piling ng Aswang (1999)

claims.statement: Ramos's book sorts Filipino folkloric creatures into twelve categories, and the aswang appears in five of them.
claims.statement_id: Buku Ramos membagi makhluk folklor Filipina ke dalam dua belas golongan, dan aswang muncul di lima di antaranya.
claims.quote: Within its pages, folkloric creatures are neatly placed into twelve categories; Demons, Dragons, Dwarves, Elves, Ghouls, Giants, Merfolk, Ogres, Vampires, Viscera Suckers, Were beasts, and Witches. What I found curious was that the aswang appeared in five of these categories

claims.statement: Each barangay gives a different answer about what an aswang is, leaving hundreds of interpretations across the country.
claims.statement_id: Tiap barangay memberi jawaban berbeda tentang apa itu aswang, sehingga ada ratusan tafsiran di seluruh Filipina.
claims.quote: Moving to the next barangay will elicit a different yet equally assertive answer. Travelling throughout the country leaves one with hundreds of interpretations.

claims.statement: The historical account quoted is from Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).
claims.statement_id: Kutipan catatan sejarah tersebut berasal dari Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589).
claims.quote: Fr. Juan de Plasencia, Customs of the Tagalogs (1589)

claims.statement: One example of a vampire aswang is the Tagalog mandurugo, said to live in the Capiz region.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu contoh aswang vampir adalah mandurugo Tagalog, yang konon tinggal di wilayah Capiz.
claims.quote: One example of a vampire aswang is the Tagalog mandurugo, said to live in the region of Capiz.

claims.statement: Aswang is also believed to be the origin of the Eastern Indonesian belief in suangi ('evil spirit', 'witch' or 'ghost').
claims.statement_id: Kata aswang juga diyakini menjadi asal kepercayaan suangi di Indonesia Timur ('roh jahat', 'penyihir', atau 'hantu').
claims.quote: It is also believed to be the origin of the Eastern Indonesian beliefs in suangi (also keswange or iwangi; "evil spirit," "witch," or "ghost").
